title: Component manifest
description: Every package, app and service in the monorepo declares itself in a component.yaml next to its package.json. The catalog tool validates these files and generates catalog/catalog.json. Machines (CI, agents, the Fleet API) read the catalog instead of inferring structure from code.

name.description: Kebab-case component name, unique across the estate.

package.description: The workspace package name (must match package.json).

depends_on.description: Workspace packages this component may import. The boundary linter rejects any @bsh import not listed here.

consumes.description: Contracts this component reads. A `deps/<repo>/contracts/...` path points at a contract owned by an external workspace root (a git submodule such as deps/scribbit); `contracts/...` is this repository's own.

secrets.description: Secret PATHS only (SOPS / Infisical). Never values.

env_schema.description: Relative path to a JSON Schema describing required environment variables.

commands.description: Standard verbs (dev, test, build, typecheck) mapped to package scripts.
